arxiv-2012-11111.title: Theory and simulations for crowding-induced changes in stability of proteins with applications to λ \lambda repressor
arxiv-2012-11111.creator: Natalia A. Denesyuk, D. Thirumalai
arxiv-2012-11111.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Natalia A. Denesyuk, D. Thirumalai. Experiments and theories have shown that when steric interactions between crowding particles and proteins are dominant, which give rise to Asakura-Oosawa depletion forces, then the stabilities of the proteins increase compared to the infinite dilution case.

arxiv-2110-01881.title: Fractal dimensions in the Gromov–Hausdorff space
arxiv-2110-01881.creator: Yoshito Ishiki
arxiv-2110-01881.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yoshito Ishiki. In this paper, we first show that for all four non-negative real numbers, there exists a Cantor ultrametric space whose Hausdorff dimension, packing dimension, upper box dimension, and Assouad dimension are equal to given four numbers, respectively.

arxiv-2112-13040.title: On the Geometric Zilber–Pink Theorem and the Lawrence–Venkatesh method
arxiv-2112-13040.creator: Gregorio Baldi, Bruno Klingler, and Emmanuel Ullmo
arxiv-2112-13040.description: Abstract . Using our recent results on the algebraicity of the Hodge locus for variations of Hodge structures of level at least 3 3 , we improve the results of Lawrence-Venkatesh in direction of the refined Bombieri–Lang conjecture. † † 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification . 11G35, 14G05, 14D07, 32Q45 † † Key words and phrases .

arxiv-2211-04549.title: Spin polarization induced by magnetic field and the relativistic Barnett effect Journal: Nuclear Physics A
arxiv-2211-04549.creator: M. Buzzegoli
arxiv-2211-04549.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by M. Buzzegoli. First, I study the analogy between the magnetization of a material and the spin polarization of particles in a fluid. Using the relativistic version of the Barnett effect, i.e. the magnetization of a material induced by mechanical rotation, the spin polarization induced by thermal vorticity is obtained within a purely classical model, where spin is treated as an intrinsic magnetic moment and rotation is included as a non-inertial effect.

arxiv-2301-02585.title: Combined mechanistic and machine learning method for construction of oil reservoir permeability map consistent with well test measurements
arxiv-2301-02585.creator: E.A. Kanin, A.A. Garipova, S.A. Boronin, V.V. Vanovsky, A.L. Vainshtein, A.A. Afanasyev, A.A. Osiptsov, E.V. Burnaev
arxiv-2301-02585.description: Abstract We propose a new method for construction of the absolute permeability map consistent with the interpreted results of well logging and well test measurements in oil reservoirs. Nadaraya-Watson kernel regression is used to approximate two-dimensional spatial distribution of the rock permeability.

arxiv-2302-01082.title: From Thin Concurrent Games to Generalized Species of Structures (extended version)
arxiv-2302-01082.creator: Pierre Clairambault, Federico Olimpieri, Hugo Paquet
arxiv-2302-01082.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Pierre Clairambault, Federico Olimpieri, Hugo Paquet. Two families of denotational models have emerged from the semantic analysis of linear logic: dynamic models, typically presented as game semantics, and static models, typically based on a category of relations. In this paper we introduce a formal bridge between a dynamic model and a static model: the model of thin concurrent games and strategies , based on event structures, and the model of generalized species of structures , based on distributors.

arxiv-2402-11080.title: The Lieb-Robinson correlation function for the quantum transverse field Ising model
arxiv-2402-11080.creator: Brendan J. Mahoney, Craig S. Lent
arxiv-2402-11080.description: Abstract The Lieb-Robinson correlation function is the norm of a commutator between local operators acting on separate subsystems at different times. This provides a useful state-independent measure for characterizing the specifically quantum interaction between spatially separated qubits. The finite propagation velocity for this correlator defines a “light-cone” of quantum influence.

arxiv-2407-07688.title: Bosonic and fermionic coherence of N-partite states in the background of a dilaton black hole
arxiv-2407-07688.creator: Wen-Mei Li 1 , Shu-Min Wu 1
arxiv-2407-07688.description: Abstract We study the N-partite coherences of GHZ and W states for free bosonic and fermionic fields when any n n observers hover near the event horizon of a Garfinkle-Horowitz-Strominger (GHS) dilaton black hole. We derive the more general analytical expressions for N-partite coherence, encompassing both physically accessible and inaccessible coherences in the context of the dilaton black hole.

arxiv-2410-18455.creator: Akitoshi Shiotari, Jun Nishida, Adnan Hammud, Fabian Schulz, Martin Wolf, Takashi Kumagai, Melanie Müller, Faradayweg 4–6, 14195 Berlin, Germany., 38 Nishigonaka, Myodaichi-cho, 444-8585 Okazaki, Japan., Faradayweg 4–6, 14195 Berlin, Germany., ∗ Corresponding author. Email: shiotari@fhi-berlin.mpg.d
arxiv-2410-18455.description: Abstract Scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM) allows for the observation of the optical response of material surfaces with a resolution far below the diffraction limit. Based on amplitude-modulation atomic force microscopy (AFM) with typical tapping amplitudes of tens of nanometers, a spatial resolution of 10–100 nm is routinely achieved in s-SNOM.

arxiv-2412-09590.title: Dissipative measure-valued solutions and weak-strong uniqueness for the Euler alignment system
arxiv-2412-09590.creator: A. Chaudhary, U. Koley, E. Wiedemann
arxiv-2412-09590.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by A. Chaudhary, U. Koley, E. Wiedemann. We introduce the concept of a dissipative measure-valued solution to the Euler alignment system. This approach incorporates a modified total energy balance, utilizing a binary tensor Young measure. The central finding is a weak (measure-valued)–strong uniqueness principle: if both a dissipative measure-valued solution and a classical smooth solution originate from the same initial data, they will be identical as long as the classical solution exists.

pmc-10520027.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). pmc-11617454.title: Protocol for autofluorescence-driven isolation of human peripheral blood eosinophils
pmc-11617454.creator: Tobias Weihrauch, Natalie Gray, N. Helge Meyer, Karin Loser, Ulrike Raap
pmc-11617454.description: SummaryMost common techniques for isolating eosinophils utilize CD16-negative selection, neglecting the CD16-positive fraction of eosinophils. pmc-12561714.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Mycotoxin contamination represents a major risk to both human and animal health. This work investigated the potential of antioxidants derived from grapeseed and sea buckthorn to mitigate the adverse effects of aflatoxin B1 (AFB1) and ochratoxin A (OTA) in weaned piglets.

pmc-12737539.title: Comparative Clinical Outcomes of Major Respiratory Viruses in Hospitalized Adults During the Post-Pandemic Period: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-12737539.creator: Hasip Kahraman, Gizem Keser, Furkan Süha Ölmezoğlu, Betül Altıntaş Öner, Onur Sedat Kurt, Tercan Us, Fatma Erdem
pmc-12737539.description: Background: In the post-pandemic era, respiratory viruses continue to cause substantial morbidity and mortality among hospitalized adults. SARS-CoV-2 and influenza remain the most common pathogens, while RSV and rhinovirus have re-emerged as relevant causes of severe illness. This study compared the characteristics and outcomes of virus-specific infections detected by multiplex real-time PCR over two consecutive seasons.

pmc-12750118.title: Effect of Nonsteroidal Anti‐Inflammatory Drugs on Sacroiliac Joint Inflammation, as Seen on Magnetic Resonance Imaging, in Axial Spondyloarthritis
pmc-12750118.creator: Gareth T Jones, Alexander N Bennett, Raj Sengupta, Pedro M Machado, Helena Marzo‐Ortega, Lorna Aucott, Margaret A Hall‐Craggs, Timothy J P Bray, Alan Bainbridge, Ruaridh M Gollifer, Gary J Macfarlane
pmc-12750118.description: ObjectiveImaging evidence of active sacroiliitis is important for diagnosis, classification, and monitoring of axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA). However, there is no consistent guidance on whether patients should temporarily stop nonsteroidal anti‐inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) before magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). The aim of this study was to determine whether NSAIDs lead to an underestimation of active sacroiliitis, as observed using MRI.

pmc-13348055.title: Within-subject alterations in CSF and blood flow dynamics following rhythm-control intervention in atrial fibrillation: An exploratory multimodal MRI study
pmc-13348055.creator: Sabine Hofer, Marlena Schnieder, Leonie Polster, Angelika S Bader, Vitali Telezki, Peter Dechent, Mathias Bähr
pmc-13348055.description: BackgroundCardiac- and respiration-driven vascular pulsations influence cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) oscillations and neurofluid dynamics and are considered relevant for perivascular fluid transport and brain homeostasis. This exploratory pre–post pilot study investigated physiological changes in CSF and blood flow dynamics following AF intervention.
